blocks.text: Quadrasystems.net Among the First in India to Achieve ISO/IEC 42001:2023, the World’s First International Standard for AI Management Systems

Quadrasystems.net India Private Limited today announced that its AI practice has achieved ISO/IEC 42001:2023 certification, the world’s first international standard for Artificial Intelligence Management Systems, following a successful audit by TÜV SÜD. A small number of organizations worldwide hold this certification; Quadrasystems.net is among the first in India.
